hooks.name: Migration Reminder on Model Change
hooks.description: Reminds to create/verify an Alembic migration when a SQLAlchemy model is changed.

action.prompt: A SQLAlchemy model file was just changed. Check whether this change alters the database schema (new/removed/renamed columns, tables, constraints, or indexes). If it does, remind the user that a matching Alembic migration is required in alembic/versions/ following the project's numbered naming convention, and that new tenant-scoped tables must call the RLS helper (_apply_rls). If the change is cosmetic (docstrings, comments, type-only hints with no column impact), state that no migration is needed.
